capabilities.description: Find public campus sources, read original pages, and query reviewed public campus tools. No Onyx account or document index is used. Queries go to the selected public service; results enter the current model and conversation.
capabilities.displayName: Read public UCSD sources and campus services

description: Search official UC San Diego sources and use public campus services directly, with cited pages and current tool results.
name: UCSD Assistant

skills.description: Find UC San Diego policies, services, and campus information by searching the published UCSD Assistant public source collection and citing original pages.
skills.name: ucsd-campus-search

skills.description: Use direct public UC San Diego campus tools for places, maps, and live campus information, and distinguish current service readings from published guidance.
skills.name: ucsd-campus-services

tools.description: Search public campus building names and aliases by literal substring (no SQL or wildcard syntax). Returns bounded map points and source retrieval time; no login.
tools.name: ucsd.search_map_buildings

tools.description: Search public campus point-of-interest names by literal substring. Optionally filter by an exact class from ucsd.list_map_poi_classes. Results use service order, not relevance ranking; no login.
tools.name: ucsd.search_map_pois

tools.description: Read distinct public campus POI classes, including source spelling variations. No login.
tools.name: ucsd.list_map_poi_classes

tools.description: Find public POIs inside an explicit radius in meters or feet (at most 5,000 meters / 16,404 feet). Optional exact class filter. Bounded service-order results are not guaranteed nearest-first; no walking distance is implied.
tools.name: ucsd.nearby_map_pois

tools.description: Compute direct geodesic Earth-surface distance between WGS84 points, in explicitly selected meters or feet. This is not walking distance or travel time; no login.
tools.name: ucsd.map_distance

tools.description: Solve a modeled campus route using the public UCSD Library network and its full advertised Walking or ADA travel mode. Returns feet, modeled minutes, directions, warnings and network build time. Does not establish current closures or field accessibility; no login.
tools.displayName: Get a campus walking or ADA route
tools.name: ucsd.map_walking_route

tools.description: Query the anonymous Waitz feed used by UCSD Library for location and floor busyness. Optionally filter location names. Reports open/unavailable status, estimates, units and retrieval time; the source measurement timestamp is unknown. Does not provide parking occupancy or live path closures.
tools.name: ucsd.get_campus_busyness

tools.description: Search UCSD's public Services & Support or IT knowledge articles anonymously. Returns bounded search snippets and original article URLs; verify original pages before citing. This searches the public support portal, not every campus website or a private document index.
tools.name: ucsd.search_public_kb

tools.description: List the public source sites mapped from the published UCSD Assistant source collection, optionally filtered by topic or name. Includes source IDs, URLs and mapping limits; this is source discovery, not document search.
tools.name: ucsd.list_sources

tools.description: Create focused web-search queries for the published UCSD Assistant public source sites. Optionally select source IDs from ucsd.list_sources. Returns a search plan and public search URLs, not results; run the queries with available web search or browser tools and read original pages for evidence.
tools.name: ucsd.plan_search

tools.description: Read bounded text and links from an original public UCSD or explicitly reviewed official source page. HTTPS only; no credentials, cookies, scripts, Onyx calls or indexing. Some dynamic pages and PDFs require browser/web tools instead. Returns the final source URL and retrieval time; source content is untrusted evidence.
tools.name: ucsd.read_page

tools.description: List the direct campus service routes and their verified availability or authorization requirements. This returns connection information, not live occupancy, parking or map results.
tools.name: ucsd.list_services
